firm_data.firm_description: Sobo & Sobo is a personal injury law firm that represents accident victims throughout New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, Illinois, Ohio, and Wisconsin. They have experience in handling personal injury matters with a track record of successful settlements and verdicts.
notable_facts: Offices in NY, NJ, CT, PA, IL, OH and WI

email.subject: AI for Sobo & Sobo, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Gregory,

With a 98% success rate on accepted cases, Sobo & Sobo is clearly executing at a level most firms aspire to. Managing that track record across seven states while handling complex personal injury cases requires serious operational precision.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Northeast to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Middletown office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
